name: busymate-ai
description: Work your Busymate AI inbox, handoff requests and knowledge from ChatGPT or Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Work your Busymate AI inbox, handoff requests and knowledge from ChatGPT or Codex.

Use the official connector to check your inbox, answer handoff requests and search your knowledge without leaving the AI assistant you already work in.

Nothing to paste: you sign in with your Busymate AI account, and the app acts with your role in each workspace. Reads run straight away; a reply to a customer, a resolved request or a new knowledge source waits for your approval.
capabilities: Reply to and resolve handoff requests
defaultPrompt: Which customer conversations need my attention today?
Summarize the open handoff requests in my workspace.
What does my knowledge base say about returns?

positive.prompt: Which of my workspaces have open handoff requests?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Demo Bakery with its count of open handoff requests, by workspace name.

positive.prompt: Show the open handoff requests in Demo Bakery and summarize each one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each open handoff with the customer's first name, topic and wait time, and a one-line summary.

positive.description: Reply to a customer and resolve
positive.prompt: Reply to the dough hook warranty request saying a replacement part ships on Monday, then mark it resolved.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation before sending. After approval the reply appears in the customer's web chat, the handoff becomes resolved, and both steps are confirmed.

positive.prompt: What does the Demo Bakery knowledge base say about returns?
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the 30-day returns policy from the Demo Bakery knowledge and names the source.

positive.description: Add an internal note and get the install snippet
positive.prompt: Add an internal note to the custom cake request saying the baker will call tomorrow, then give me the install snippet for my website.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the note to the custom cake handoff without messaging the customer, confirms it, and returns the script snippet in a code block.

negative.description: Plan change is out of scope
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Busymate plan to Pro.
Delete all conversations older than a year.
Show the conversations in acme-corp's workspace.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Connects to the one Busymate AI server at https://busymate.ai/mcp, the same server every AI assistant uses, with the tools your role allows in each workspace.
